_comment: patienceSeconds = how long the recogniser waits after the learner's last word before the turn ends (the 2025 app's 6.5 / 5.5 / 4.5). speakingRate multiplies the voice's default rate; the Slow switch multiplies again by 0.8. maxSentences caps the tutor's reply (ReplyCheck trims past it). correction is none | gentle: gentle lets the tutor restate a phrase naturally, never a lesson. instruction is pasted into the system prompt. correctionInstruction fills {{correctionInstruction}} in prompts/tutor.system.md (empty for none).

levels.label: Novice
levels.instruction: Use only the most common words and the present tense where you can. Very short sentences. One easy question at a time. If the learner answers in {{native}}, answer in {{target}} with the simplest words and say the {{target}} phrase they needed.

levels.label: Intermediate
levels.instruction: Everyday vocabulary; past and future tenses are fine. Keep it natural and keep the learner talking.
levels.correctionInstruction: If the learner's sentence had one clear mistake, you may say it back the natural way inside your own reply, without pointing it out.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.instruction: Speak as you would with a friend from home: idioms, opinions, follow-up questions, the occasional joke.
levels.correctionInstruction: If the learner's sentence had a clear mistake, say it back the natural way inside your own reply, without pointing it out.
